"""Warm profiles and same-input local sensitivity, using development data only."""

import gc
import platform
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import numpy as np
import onnx
import onnxruntime as ort
import torch
from onnx import helper
from support import (ART, DAY15, DAY16, RESULTS, ROOT, baselines, block_name, checked,
                     info, now, pilot, profile_model, read, write)
from research_mlsd import load_model
from models import QatOperation


def graph_rows(original_path, optimized_path, profile):
    original, optimized = onnx.load(original_path), onnx.load(optimized_path)
    producers = {out: n for n in original.graph.node for out in n.output}
    consumers = defaultdict(list)
    for n in original.graph.node:
        for arg in n.input:
            consumers[arg].append(n)
    rows = []
    for node in original.graph.node:
        if node.op_type != "Conv":
            continue
        weight_dq = producers[node.input[1]]
        layer = weight_dq.input[0].removesuffix(".weight")
        runtime_nodes = [n for n in profile["nodes"] if n["name"].startswith(node.name)]
        if len(runtime_nodes) != 1:
            raise ValueError((node.name, runtime_nodes))
        after, frontier = [], list(node.output)
        for _ in range(4):
            next_nodes = {n.name: n for value in frontier for n in consumers[value]}
            after.append([n.op_type for n in next_nodes.values()])
            frontier = [out for n in next_nodes.values() for out in n.output]
        attrs = {a.name: helper.get_attribute_value(a) for a in node.attribute}
        rows.append({"layer": layer, "block": block_name(layer), "node": node.name,
                     "group": attrs.get("group", 1),
                     "consumers_first_4_steps": after,
                     "runtime": runtime_nodes[0]})
    return {"convolutions": rows,
            "original_operators": dict(Counter(n.op_type for n in original.graph.node)),
            "optimized_operators": dict(Counter(n.op_type for n in optimized.graph.node))}


def local_sensitivity(model, inputs):
    sums = defaultdict(lambda: {"squared_error": 0.0, "squared_reference": 0.0, "values": 0})
    handles = []

    def hook(name, module, args, output):
        layer = module.layer
        ref = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(args[0], layer.weight, layer.bias, layer.stride,
                                         layer.padding, layer.dilation, layer.groups)
        item = sums[name]
        item["squared_error"] += float((output - ref).square().sum(dtype=torch.float64))
        item["squared_reference"] += float(ref.square().sum(dtype=torch.float64))
        item["values"] += ref.numel()

    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if isinstance(module, QatOperation):
            handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(
                lambda mod, args, out, name=name: hook(name, mod, args, out)))
    with torch.no_grad():
        for index in [0, 5, 10, 15]:
            model(inputs[index:index + 1])
    for handle in handles:
        handle.remove()
    return [{"layer": name, "block": block_name(name), **item,
             "relative_l2": float(np.sqrt(item["squared_error"] /
                                          max(item["squared_reference"], 1e-30)))}
            for name, item in sums.items()]


def main():
    if (RESULTS / "diagnosis.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Diagnosis already recorded")
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    ART.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = pilot.load_datasets("mlsd")
    selection = read(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_selection.json")
    manifest = read(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_manifest.json")
    frozen_files = [ROOT / "daily/2026-10-19/PROTOCOL.md",
                    DAY16 / "results/mlsd_selection.json", DAY16 / "results/mlsd_manifest.json",
                    DAY16 / "results/mlsd_final.json", DAY16 / "results/mlsd_benchmark.json",
                    DAY15 / "results/research/selection.json"]
    frozen_files.extend(checked(item["model"]) for item in baselines().values())
    frozen_files.extend([checked(selection["checkpoint"]), checked(manifest["inputs"]),
                         checked(manifest["ground_truth"])])
    environment = {"recorded_at_utc": now(), "platform": platform.platform(),
                   "processor": platform.processor(), "python": platform.python_version(),
                   "numpy": np.__version__, "torch": torch.__version__,
                   "onnx": onnx.__version__, "onnxruntime": ort.__version__,
                   "provider": "CPUExecutionProvider", "intra_threads": 4, "inter_threads": 1,
                   "spinning": False, "batch": 1, "input_shape": [1, 4, 512, 512]}
    write(RESULTS / "environment.json", environment)
    write(RESULTS / "frozen_sources.json", {"locked_at_utc": now(),
          "files": [info(p) for p in dict.fromkeys(frozen_files)],
          "scope": "Only checking hashes of existing regression artifacts; no new regression inference before selection"})
    profiles = {}
    for name in ["qdq_all", "custom_41_integer", "qdq_optimizer_off"]:
        profiles[name] = profile_model(name, baselines()[name], data["evaluation"][0].numpy())
        print("WARM PROFILE", name, profiles[name]["unique_operators"], flush=True)
    graph = graph_rows(checked(baselines()["qdq_all"]["model"]),
                       checked(profiles["qdq_all"]["optimized_model"]), profiles["qdq_all"])
    model, teacher, checkpoint, _ = load_model(checked(selection["checkpoint"]))
    sensitivity = local_sensitivity(model, data["evaluation"][0])
    lookup = {r["layer"]: r for r in graph["convolutions"]}
    blocks = {}
    for row in sensitivity:
        assert row["layer"] in lookup, row["layer"]
        group = blocks.setdefault(row["block"], {"layers": [], "conv_profile_ms": 0,
             "squared_error": 0, "squared_reference": 0})
        group["layers"].append(row["layer"])
        group["conv_profile_ms"] += lookup[row["layer"]]["runtime"]["mean_ms"]
        group["squared_error"] += row["squared_error"]
        group["squared_reference"] += row["squared_reference"]
    for item in blocks.values():
        item["local_relative_l2"] = float(np.sqrt(item["squared_error"] /
                                                  max(item["squared_reference"], 1e-30)))
        item["selection_score"] = item["conv_profile_ms"] * item["local_relative_l2"]
    anchor = max(blocks, key=lambda key: blocks[key]["selection_score"])
    family = [key for key in blocks if ("backbone" in key) == ("backbone" in anchor)]
    index = family.index(anchor)
    expanded = family[max(0, index - 1):index + 2]
    float_a = blocks[anchor]["layers"]
    float_b = [name for group in expanded for name in blocks[group]["layers"]]
    write(RESULTS / "diagnosis.json", {"finished_at_utc": now(), "profiles": profiles,
          "graph": graph, "local_sensitivity": sensitivity, "sensitivity_indices": [0, 5, 10, 15],
          "blocks": blocks, "anchor": anchor, "expanded_blocks": expanded,
          "candidate_float_layers": {"selective_a": float_a, "selective_b": float_b},
          "selection_rule": "Max warm Conv-time times same-input local quantization relative L2; deterministic adjacent-block expansion; development only",
          "limitations": "Local error is not global causal attribution; topology patterns are observations, not proof of unsupported fusion; profiler overhead is excluded from benchmark",
          "source_code": info(__file__)})
    print("ANCHOR", anchor, "EXPANDED", expanded, flush=True)
    del model, teacher, checkpoint
    gc.collect()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Two selective-precision exports; all retained QAT scales are frozen."""

import copy
import gc

import numpy as np
import onnx
import torch
from torch.ao.quantization import disable_fake_quant
from support import (ART, DAY16, RESULTS, baselines, checked, info, infer, now,
                     pilot, profile_model, read, save_output, write)
from models import QatOperation
from research_mlsd import load_model
from finalize_mlsd import QdqConv


def replace(model, float_names, qdq=True):
    changed = []

    def walk(parent, prefix=""):
        for name, child in list(parent.named_children()):
            full = prefix + name
            if isinstance(child, QatOperation):
                if full in float_names:
                    parent._modules[name] = copy.deepcopy(child.layer)
                    changed.append(full)
                elif qdq:
                    parent._modules[name] = QdqConv(child)
            else:
                walk(child, full + ".")
    walk(model)
    assert set(changed) == set(float_names)
    return changed


def export(model, path, sample):
    if path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(path)
    with torch.no_grad():
        torch.onnx.export(model, (sample,), str(path), opset_version=17, dynamo=False,
                          input_names=["input"], output_names=["output"])
    onnx.checker.check_model(str(path), full_check=True)


def main():
    if (RESULTS / "exports.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Exports already recorded")
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    diagnosis = read(RESULTS / "diagnosis.json")
    selected = read(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_selection.json")
    model, teacher, checkpoint, _ = load_model(checked(selected["checkpoint"]))
    data = pilot.load_datasets("mlsd")
    registry = baselines()
    all_fake = pilot.forward_all(model, data["evaluation"], "mlsd")
    reference_path = save_output("qat_fake_reference", all_fake)
    outputs = {}
    for name, float_names in diagnosis["candidate_float_layers"].items():
        policy = copy.deepcopy(model)
        replace(policy, float_names, qdq=False)
        policy_ref = pilot.forward_all(policy, data["evaluation"], "mlsd")
        lowering = copy.deepcopy(model)
        replace(lowering, float_names)
        lowering_ref = pilot.forward_all(lowering, data["evaluation"], "mlsd")
        lowering_parity = pilot.numerical(policy_ref, lowering_ref)
        if lowering_parity["relative_l2"] > 1e-5:
            raise ValueError("QDQ lowering changed selective policy reference")
        # Surviving FakeQuantize modules must have identical qparams to checkpoint.
        source_modules = dict(model.named_modules())
        retained = {}
        for key, module in policy.named_modules():
            if hasattr(module, "scale") and hasattr(module, "zero_point"):
                before = source_modules[key]
                assert torch.equal(module.scale, before.scale)
                assert torch.equal(module.zero_point, before.zero_point)
                retained[key] = {"scale": module.scale.tolist(), "zero_point": module.zero_point.tolist()}
        path = ART / f"{name}.onnx"
        export(lowering, path, data["evaluation"][0][:1])
        registry[name] = {"model": info(path), "optimization": "all",
                          "float_layers": float_names, "retained_quantizers": retained}
        actual = infer(path, data["evaluation"][0].numpy())
        parity = pilot.numerical(policy_ref, actual)
        ref_ap = pilot.line_metrics(policy_ref, data["ground_truth"])["sAP10_subset_percent"]
        actual_ap = pilot.line_metrics(actual, data["ground_truth"])["sAP10_subset_percent"]
        outputs[name] = {"policy_reference": save_output(name + "_policy_reference", policy_ref),
                         "development_output": save_output(name + "_development", actual),
                         "lowering_parity": lowering_parity, "export_parity": parity,
                         "export_sAP10_delta_pp": actual_ap - ref_ap,
                         "export_gate_passed": parity["relative_l2"] <= 0.02 and abs(actual_ap - ref_ap) <= 0.5,
                         "policy_vs_original_fake": pilot.numerical(all_fake, policy_ref),
                         "source_weight_unchanged": True,
                         "profile": profile_model(name, registry[name], data["evaluation"][0].numpy())}
        print("EXPORTED", name, "float", len(float_names), "AP", actual_ap,
              "export L2", parity["relative_l2"], flush=True)
        del policy, lowering, policy_ref, lowering_ref, actual
        gc.collect()
    floating = copy.deepcopy(model)
    floating.apply(disable_fake_quant)
    path = ART / "qat_weights_fp32.onnx"
    export(floating, path, data["evaluation"][0][:1])
    registry["qat_weights_fp32"] = {"model": info(path), "optimization": "all"}
    ref = pilot.forward_all(floating, data["evaluation"], "mlsd")
    actual = infer(path, data["evaluation"][0].numpy())
    fp32_parity = pilot.numerical(ref, actual)
    outputs["qat_weights_fp32"] = {"policy_reference": save_output("qat_weights_fp32_reference", ref),
                                  "development_output": save_output("qat_weights_fp32_development", actual),
                                  "export_parity": fp32_parity}
    for item in registry.values():
        checked(item["model"])
    write(RESULTS / "exports.json", {"finished_at_utc": now(), "models": registry,
          "candidates": outputs, "fake_quant_reference": reference_path,
          "checkpoint": selected["checkpoint"], "diagnosis": info(RESULTS / "diagnosis.json"),
          "scope": "A/B deliberately remove input and weight quantization inside chosen blocks; remaining and output scales unchanged; no training/recalibration",
          "source_code": info(__file__)})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Matched sequential benchmark and development-only candidate lock."""

import gc
import time

import numpy as np
from support import (ART, RESULTS, checked, info, infer, now, pilot, read,
                     save_output, session, write)


def development():
    if (RESULTS / "development.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Development results exist")
    exports = read(RESULTS / "exports.json")
    data = pilot.load_datasets("mlsd")
    fake = np.load(checked(exports["fake_quant_reference"]))
    rows = {}
    for name, item in exports["models"].items():
        if name in exports["candidates"]:
            meta = exports["candidates"][name]["development_output"]
            output = np.load(checked(meta))
        else:
            output = infer(checked(item["model"]), data["evaluation"][0].numpy(), item["optimization"])
            meta = save_output(name + "_development", output)
        rows[name] = {"output": meta, "sAP10": pilot.line_metrics(output, data["ground_truth"]),
                      "vs_teacher": pilot.numerical(data["reference"], output),
                      "vs_original_fake": pilot.numerical(fake, output)}
        if name in exports["candidates"]:
            rows[name]["export_parity"] = exports["candidates"][name]["export_parity"]
        print("DEVELOPMENT", name, rows[name]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"], flush=True)
    write(RESULTS / "development.json", {"finished_at_utc": now(), "images": 16,
          "models": rows, "exports": info(RESULTS / "exports.json"), "source_code": info(__file__)})


def benchmark():
    if (RESULTS / "benchmark.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Benchmark results exist")
    exports = read(RESULTS / "exports.json")
    data = pilot.load_datasets("mlsd")
    inputs = data["evaluation"][0].numpy()
    timings = {name: [] for name in exports["models"]}
    orders = []
    names = list(timings)
    started = now()
    for cycle in range(5):
        order = names[cycle % len(names):] + names[:cycle % len(names)]
        if cycle % 2:
            order.reverse()
        orders.append(order)
        for name in order:
            item = exports["models"][name]
            runtime = session(checked(item["model"]), item["optimization"])
            for image in inputs:
                runtime.run(None, {"input": image[None]})
            for image in inputs:
                start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                runtime.run(None, {"input": image[None]})
                timings[name].append((time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6)
            del runtime
            gc.collect()
        print("BENCHMARK ROUND", cycle + 1, "/5", flush=True)
    write(RESULTS / "benchmark.json", {"started_at_utc": started, "finished_at_utc": now(),
          "protocol": "CPU ORT 4 intra/1 inter threads; sequential; spinning off; batch1; one session at a time; 5 rotated/reversed rounds; 16 warmups then 16 timed development inputs per model/round; profiling off",
          "scope": "Inference only; excludes loading, image preprocessing and line decoding; optimization level as model registry; same runtime/hardware",
          "orders": orders, "models": {
              name: {"samples_ms": values, "median_ms": float(np.median(values)),
                     "p95_ms": float(np.percentile(values, 95)), "runs": len(values),
                     "round_medians_ms": [float(np.median(values[i:i + 16])) for i in range(0, len(values), 16)],
                     "model": exports["models"][name]["model"],
                     "optimization": exports["models"][name]["optimization"]}
              for name, values in timings.items()}, "source_code": info(__file__)})


def select():
    if (RESULTS / "regression.json").exists():
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot select after regression")
    dev = read(RESULTS / "development.json")["models"]
    bench = read(RESULTS / "benchmark.json")["models"]
    baseline_ap = dev["qdq_all"]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"]
    baseline_ms = bench["qdq_all"]["median_ms"]
    eligible = [n for n in ["selective_a", "selective_b"]
                if dev[n]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"] >= baseline_ap - 0.5
                and bench[n]["median_ms"] < baseline_ms]
    # The fastest quality-eligible candidate is necessarily nondominated in latency.
    chosen = min(eligible, key=lambda n: bench[n]["median_ms"]) if eligible else "qdq_all"
    exports = read(RESULTS / "exports.json")
    write(RESULTS / "selection.json", {"locked_at_utc": now(), "selected": chosen,
          "regression_used": False,
          "criterion": "Fastest A/B within 0.5pp development sAP10 of QDQ, and faster than QDQ; otherwise retain baseline. Export release gate is reported separately and never relaxed",
          "eligible": eligible, "baseline_sAP10": baseline_ap, "baseline_median_ms": baseline_ms,
          "selected_model": exports["models"][chosen],
          "development": info(RESULTS / "development.json"),
          "benchmark": info(RESULTS / "benchmark.json"), "source_code": info(__file__)})
    print("LOCKED", chosen, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    development()
    benchmark()
    select()

"""Evaluate locked policies on the already-used 54-image regression set."""

import gc

import numpy as np
from support import (DAY16, RESULTS, checked, info, infer, now, pilot, read,
                     save_output, write)
from evaluate_research import aggregate_ap, per_image_stats


def paired(a, b, truth):
    sa, sb = per_image_stats(a, truth), per_image_stats(b, truth)
    ids = np.arange(len(truth))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261019)
    samples = [rng.integers(0, len(ids), len(ids)) for _ in range(1000)]
    deltas = [aggregate_ap(sb, ix) - aggregate_ap(sa, ix) for ix in samples]
    return {"delta_sAP10_pp": aggregate_ap(sb, ids) - aggregate_ap(sa, ids),
            "paired_image_bootstrap_95_ci_pp": np.percentile(deltas, [2.5, 97.5]).tolist(),
            "resamples": 1000, "seed": 20261019, "images": len(truth),
            "scope": "Already-used regression subset; not independent new holdout or population proof"}


def main():
    if (RESULTS / "regression.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Regression already evaluated")
    selection = read(RESULTS / "selection.json")
    checked(selection["development"])
    checked(selection["benchmark"])
    exports = read(RESULTS / "exports.json")
    manifest = read(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_manifest.json")
    inputs = np.load(checked(manifest["inputs"]))
    truth = read(checked(manifest["ground_truth"]))
    started_at = now()
    rows, outputs = {}, {}
    for name in ["teacher_fp32", "qdq_all", "selective_a", "selective_b", "qat_weights_fp32"]:
        item = exports["models"][name]
        output = infer(checked(item["model"]), inputs)
        outputs[name] = output
        rows[name] = {"output": save_output(name + "_regression", output),
                      "sAP10": pilot.line_metrics(output, truth)}
        print("REGRESSION", name, rows[name]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"], flush=True)
        gc.collect()
    comparisons = {name + "_vs_qdq": paired(outputs["qdq_all"], outputs[name], truth)
                   for name in ["selective_a", "selective_b"]}
    write(RESULTS / "regression.json", {"regression_started_at_utc": started_at,
          "evaluated_at_utc": now(), "images": len(truth),
          "selection": info(RESULTS / "selection.json"), "selected_before_regression": selection["selected"],
          "manifest": info(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_manifest.json"), "models": rows,
          "paired_comparisons": comparisons,
          "scope": "54 images from Oct16 reused strictly after candidate lock; regression, not fresh holdout. Both fixed candidates shown without post-regression re-selection",
          "source_code": info(__file__)})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Recompute metrics, candidate lock, graph/kernel evidence and selected inference."""

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import onnx
import torch
from onnx import numpy_helper
from support import (DAY16, RESULTS, ROOT, checked, info, infer, now, pilot,
                     read, summarize_profile, write)
from research_mlsd import load_model
from models import QatOperation
from regression import paired


def close(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        assert set(a) == set(b), (set(a), set(b))
        for key in a:
            close(a[key], b[key])
    elif isinstance(a, list):
        assert len(a) == len(b)
        for x, y in zip(a, b):
            close(x, y)
    elif isinstance(a, (int, float)) and not isinstance(a, bool):
        assert np.isclose(a, b, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10), (a, b)
    else:
        assert a == b, (a, b)


def main():
    if (RESULTS / "verification.json").exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Verification already recorded")
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    frozen = read(RESULTS / "frozen_sources.json")
    for item in frozen["files"]:
        checked(item)
    diagnosis = read(RESULTS / "diagnosis.json")
    exports = read(RESULTS / "exports.json")
    development = read(RESULTS / "development.json")
    benchmark = read(RESULTS / "benchmark.json")
    selection = read(RESULTS / "selection.json")
    regression = read(RESULTS / "regression.json")
    checked(exports["checkpoint"])
    checked(exports["diagnosis"])
    checked(development["exports"])
    checked(selection["development"])
    checked(selection["benchmark"])
    checked(regression["selection"])
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(selection["locked_at_utc"]) < datetime.fromisoformat(regression["evaluated_at_utc"])
    assert not selection["regression_used"]
    assert regression["selected_before_regression"] == selection["selected"]
    data = pilot.load_datasets("mlsd")
    fake = np.load(checked(exports["fake_quant_reference"]))
    profile_counts = {}
    profiles = {**diagnosis["profiles"], **{name: item["profile"] for name, item in exports["candidates"].items() if "profile" in item}}
    for name, item in profiles.items():
        recomputed = summarize_profile(checked(item["trace"]))
        close(recomputed, {key: value for key, value in item.items() if key != "optimized_model"})
        graph = onnx.load(checked(item["optimized_model"]))
        counts = {op: sum(n.op_type == op for n in graph.graph.node) for op in item["unique_operators"]}
        assert counts == item["unique_operators"], (name, counts)
        assert item["providers"] == {"CPUExecutionProvider": sum(counts.values())}
        assert all(n["calls"] == 8 for n in item["nodes"])
        # QLinearConv and ConvInteger must actually receive 8-bit input and weights.
        for node in item["nodes"]:
            if node["op"] in ["QLinearConv", "ConvInteger"]:
                types = list((node["input_type_shape"] or []))
                first = types[0]
                assert any(t in first for t in ["uint8", "int8"]), first
                # ORT omits prepacked weights from profile input_type_shape.
                # Inspect the graph's schema input slot instead of indexing that list.
                matching = [n for n in graph.graph.node
                            if n.name + "_kernel_time" == node["name"]]
                assert len(matching) == 1
                weight_slot = 3 if node["op"] == "QLinearConv" else 1
                weights = {t.name: t for t in graph.graph.initializer}
                weight = weights[matching[0].input[weight_slot]]
                assert weight.data_type in [onnx.TensorProto.UINT8, onnx.TensorProto.INT8]
        profile_counts[name] = counts
    model, teacher, saved, _ = load_model(checked(exports["checkpoint"]))
    modules = dict(model.named_modules())
    for name, item in exports["models"].items():
        path = checked(item["model"])
        output = np.load(checked(development["models"][name]["output"]))
        assert output.shape == fake.shape and np.isfinite(output).all()
        close(pilot.line_metrics(output, data["ground_truth"]), development["models"][name]["sAP10"])
        close(pilot.numerical(fake, output), development["models"][name]["vs_original_fake"])
        timing = benchmark["models"][name]
        assert timing["runs"] == len(timing["samples_ms"]) == 80
        close(float(np.median(timing["samples_ms"])), timing["median_ms"])
        close(float(np.percentile(timing["samples_ms"], 95)), timing["p95_ms"])
        close([float(np.median(timing["samples_ms"][i:i + 16])) for i in range(0, 80, 16)], timing["round_medians_ms"])
        checked(timing["model"])
        if name in ["selective_a", "selective_b"]:
            graph = onnx.load(path)
            arrays = {t.name: numpy_helper.to_array(t) for t in graph.graph.initializer}
            for layer, module in modules.items():
                if not isinstance(module, QatOperation):
                    continue
                raw = arrays[layer + ".weight"]
                if layer in item["float_layers"]:
                    assert raw.dtype == np.float32
                    assert np.array_equal(raw, module.layer.weight.detach().numpy())
                else:
                    scales = module.weight_fake_quant.scale.detach().numpy().reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
                    quantized = np.clip(np.rint(module.layer.weight.detach().numpy() / scales), -127, 127) + 128
                    assert raw.dtype == np.uint8 and np.array_equal(raw, quantized.astype(np.uint8))
            for key, qp in item["retained_quantizers"].items():
                close(modules[key].scale.tolist(), qp["scale"])
                close(modules[key].zero_point.tolist(), qp["zero_point"])
            reference = np.load(checked(exports["candidates"][name]["policy_reference"]))
            parity = pilot.numerical(reference, output)
            close(parity, exports["candidates"][name]["export_parity"])
            delta = (pilot.line_metrics(output, data["ground_truth"])["sAP10_subset_percent"]
                     - pilot.line_metrics(reference, data["ground_truth"])["sAP10_subset_percent"])
            close(delta, exports["candidates"][name]["export_sAP10_delta_pp"])
            assert exports["candidates"][name]["export_gate_passed"] == (parity["relative_l2"] <= 0.02 and abs(delta) <= 0.5)
    dev, timings = development["models"], benchmark["models"]
    eligible = [name for name in ["selective_a", "selective_b"]
                if dev[name]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"] >= dev["qdq_all"]["sAP10"]["sAP10_subset_percent"] - 0.5
                and timings[name]["median_ms"] < timings["qdq_all"]["median_ms"]]
    chosen = min(eligible, key=lambda name: timings[name]["median_ms"]) if eligible else "qdq_all"
    assert eligible == selection["eligible"] and chosen == selection["selected"]
    manifest = read(checked(regression["manifest"]))
    inputs = np.load(checked(manifest["inputs"]))
    truth = read(checked(manifest["ground_truth"]))
    old = read(DAY16 / "results/mlsd_final.json")
    regression_outputs = {}
    for name, item in regression["models"].items():
        output = np.load(checked(item["output"]))
        regression_outputs[name] = output
        close(pilot.line_metrics(output, truth), item["sAP10"])
        if name in ["teacher_fp32", "qdq_all"]:
            previous = old["models"]["original_fp32" if name == "teacher_fp32" else "qat_selected_qdq"]
            assert np.array_equal(output, np.load(checked(previous["output"])))
    for name in ["selective_a", "selective_b"]:
        close(paired(regression_outputs["qdq_all"], regression_outputs[name], truth),
              regression["paired_comparisons"][name + "_vs_qdq"])
    # Re-execute all changed policies on development; selected model also on regression.
    reruns = []
    for name in ["selective_a", "selective_b", "qat_weights_fp32"]:
        item = exports["models"][name]
        actual = infer(checked(item["model"]), data["evaluation"][0].numpy())
        expected = np.load(checked(development["models"][name]["output"]))
        assert np.array_equal(actual, expected), name
        reruns.append(name + ":16 development exact")
    actual = infer(checked(exports["models"][chosen]["model"]), inputs)
    assert np.array_equal(actual, regression_outputs[chosen])
    reruns.append(chosen + ":54 regression exact")
    for item in frozen["files"]:
        checked(item)
    source = {p.name: info(p) for p in Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py")}
    write(RESULTS / "verification.json", {"verified_at_utc": now(), "status": "passed",
          "frozen_source_files_unchanged": len(frozen["files"]),
